bosses_required.why: Fewer bosses before Bowser is a shorter, easier run; all eleven is a full gauntlet.

level_shuffle.why: Levels turn up in unfamiliar places, so you cannot lean on memory of the game.

boss_shuffle.why: Bosses appear in other boss slots, so each fight can be a surprise.

bowser_castle_rooms.why: Longer forced room sequences make the end of the run harder than picking your own rooms.

trap_fill_percentage.why: Traps replace junk items, so more of them means more setbacks.

starting_life_count.why: More starting lives is a bigger safety net.

exclude_special_zone.why: Nothing required is placed in the hardest levels.

death_link.why: When any player dies, everyone dies.

accessibility.why: Minimal accessibility only promises the goal can be finished.
